model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the number of building permits issued for new constructions in Bulgaria from 2012 to 2022, categorized by type of building, based on data from the National Statistical Institute (NSI). The horizontal axis represents the years from 2012 to 2022, labeled with the year in Cyrillic script (e.g., “2012 г.”), and is presented on a linear scale with evenly spaced tick marks. The vertical axis represents the number of permits issued, with values ranging from approximately 4,000 to over 8,000, and is also on a linear scale. The plot contains three lines: a blue line with circular markers labeled “Административни” (Administrative), an orange line with circular markers labeled “Други” (Other), and a gray line with circular markers labeled “Жилищни” (Residential). The blue line starts at 4,238 in 2012 and ends at 4,631 in 2022, showing a general upward trend with a dip to 4,120 in 2013 and a peak of 4,938 in 2012. The orange line begins at 4,938 in 2012, declines to 4,674 in 2013, then rises to 4,685 in 2016, peaks at 5,460 in 2017, dips to 4,608 in 2019, and ends at 4,631 in 2022. The gray line starts at 4,238 in 2012, rises to 5,562 in 2017, peaks at 8,169 in 2022, and includes intermediate values such as 5,980 in 2019 and 5,860 in 2020.
